2607.08252.title: AutoPersonas: A Multi-Timescale Loop Engine for Open-Ended Persona Evolution
2607.08252.paper_summary: Long-term persona agents must remain identifiable while adapting to new events, relationships, evidence, and social conditions. We identify self-locking as a runtime failure mode in continuing persona-life loops: locally plausible events keep appearing while the generated life collapses toward familiar environments, weak relationships, suspended decisions, and stale life stages. We trace this failure to model-level convergence toward high-probability behavioral channels and system-level context gravity from State, memory, history, and environment summaries. We introduce AutoPersonas, a multi-timescale life-environment engine for bounded persona-level recursive self-evolution. It separates environment-side Occurrences, accumulated Observations, and persona State. Its OSO loop admits divergent future-facing material while requiring evidence-governed absorption before State or reachability changes. A three-year compressed simulation exposed environment watermark shells, occurrence-hardening gaps, slow-change accumulation failures, recursive indecision, and weak relationship persistence. An eight-model 40-day stress test generated 1,600 events and found mean rolling 5-day action-category repetition of 95.2%-97.6%, with all models crossing 90% by day 11. Semantic re-keeping found 79.0%-88.0% macro-theme repetition across all direct-loop runs. In a same-runtime 40-day A/B, context-slice masking plus per-sample divergence targeting reduced macro-theme repetition from 61.8% to 36.3% and roughly doubled cumulative theme count. A juvenile-goblin fictional-world run reproduced the anti-fixation regime without hard real-world intrusions. These results support a bounded claim: separating controlled divergence from evidence-governed absorption can reduce persona-environment self-locking while preserving identity continuity.
2607.08252.paper_summary_zh: 長期的人格代理必須在適應新事件、關係、證據和社會條件的同時保持可識別性。<lb/>我們將自我鎖定識別為持續人格生命循環中的一種運行時失敗模式：當生成的生命向熟悉的環境、薄弱的關係、懸而未決的決策和陳舊的生命階段崩潰時，局部合理的事件不斷出現。<lb/>我們將這一失敗追溯到模型層級向高概率行為通道的收斂以及來自狀態、記憶、歷史和環境摘要的系統層級上下文引力。<lb/>我們引入了AutoPersonas，一個多時間尺度的生命環境引擎，用於有限的人格層級遞歸自我演化。<lb/>它將環境側的事件、累積的觀察和人格狀態分開。<lb/>其OSO循環允許面向未來的多樣材料，同時要求在狀態或可達性變化之前進行以證據為依據的吸收。<lb/>一個三年的壓縮模擬揭示了環境水印殼、事件硬化間隙、緩慢變化的累積失敗、遞歸的猶豫和薄弱的關係持續性。<lb/>一個八模型的40天壓力測試生成了1,600個事件，發現平均滾動5天的行動類別重複率為95.2%-97.6%，所有模型在第11天均超過90%。<lb/>語義重保持在所有直接循環運行中發現了79.0%-88.0%的宏主題重複。<lb/>在同一運行時的40天A/B測試中，情境切片遮罩加上每個樣本的多樣性目標將宏主題重複率從61.8%降低到36.3%，並大約將累積主題數量翻倍。<lb/>一個幼年哥布林虛構世界的運行再現了反固定化體系，沒有硬性現實世界的干擾。<lb/>這些結果支持一個有限的主張：將受控的多樣性與以證據為依據的吸收分開可以減少人格環境的自我鎖定，同時保持身份的連續性。
2607.08252.author: Mengchen Li et.al.
